+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TranslationConfig:
+    api_key: Optional[str] = None
+    model: str = "gpt-4.1-mini"
+    source_language: str = "auto"
+    target_language: str = "en"
+
+
+def load_translation_config() -> TranslationConfig:
+    return TranslationConfig(
+        api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
+        model=os.getenv("OPENAI_TRANSLATION_MODEL", "gpt-4.1-mini"),
+        source_language=os.getenv("OPENAI_TRANSLATION_SOURCE_LANGUAGE", "auto"),
+        target_language=os.getenv("OPENAI_TRANSLATION_TARGET_LANGUAGE", "en"),
+    )
+
+
+def create_translation_client(config: Optional[TranslationConfig] = None) -> OpenAI:
+    cfg = config or load_translation_config()
+    kwargs = {}
+    if cfg.api_key:
+        kwargs["api_key"] = cfg.api_key
+    return OpenAI(**kwargs)
+
+
+def translate_script(text: str, config: Optional[TranslationConfig] = None) -> str:
+    cfg = config or load_translation_config()
+    client = create_translation_client(cfg)
+    prompt = (
+        f"Translate the following narration script from {cfg.source_language} to {cfg.target_language}. "
+        "Preserve meaning, punctuation, line breaks, and narration style. Return only the translated script.\n\n"
+        f"{text}"
+    )
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model=cfg.model,
+        input=prompt,
+    )
+    return response.output_text.strip()
+
*** End Patch

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Mapping, Optional
+
+
+def _clean_text(value: Any) -> str:
+    if value is None:
+        return ""
+    text = str(value).strip()
+    return " ".join(text.split())
+
+
+def _normalize_voice(value: Any) -> str:
+    voice = _clean_text(value)
+    return voice or "default"
+
+
+def _normalize_format(value: Any) -> str:
+    audio_format = _clean_text(value).lower()
+    return audio_format or "mp3"
+
+
+def _normalize_speed(value: Any) -> float:
+    try:
+        speed = float(value)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return 1.0
+    if speed <= 0:
+        return 1.0
+    return speed
+
+
+@dataclass(slots=True)
+class TTSRequest:
+    text: str
+    voice: str = "default"
+    audio_format: str = "mp3"
+    speed: float = 1.0
+    sample_rate: Optional[int] = None
+    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_mapping(cls, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "TTSRequest":
+        return cls(
+            text=_clean_text(data.get("text")),
+            voice=_normalize_voice(data.get("voice")),
+            audio_format=_normalize_format(data.get("audio_format") or data.get("format")),
+            speed=_normalize_speed(data.get("speed")),
+            sample_rate=data.get("sample_rate"),
+            metadata=dict(data.get("metadata") or {}),
+        )
+
+    def normalized(self) -> "TTSRequest":
+        return type(self).from_mapping(self.__dict__)
+
+
+@dataclass(slots=True)
+class TTSResponse:
+    audio: bytes = b""
+    audio_format: str = "mp3"
+    sample_rate: Optional[int] = None
+    voice: str = "default"
+    text: str = ""
+    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_mapping(cls, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "TTSResponse":
+        audio = data.get("audio") or data.get("content") or b""
+        if isinstance(audio, str):
+            audio = audio.encode("utf-8")
+        return cls(
+            audio=audio,
+            audio_format=_normalize_format(data.get("audio_format") or data.get("format")),
+            sample_rate=data.get("sample_rate"),
+            voice=_normalize_voice(data.get("voice")),
+            text=_clean_text(data.get("text")),
+            metadata=dict(data.get("metadata") or {}),
+        )
+
+    def normalized(self) -> "TTSResponse":
+        return type(self).from_mapping(self.__dict__)

+import os

+
+
+def synthesize_ssml(ssml: str, output_path: str, voice: str = "en-US-JennyNeural", prosody_rate: str = "0%", prosody_pitch: str = "0%") -> None:
+    subscription_key = os.environ["AZURE_SPEECH_KEY"]
+    region = os.environ["AZURE_SPEECH_REGION"]
+    endpoint = f"https://{region}.tts.speech.microsoft.com/cognitiveservices/v1"
+    headers = {
+        "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": subscription_key,
+        "Content-Type": "application/ssml+xml",
+        "X-Microsoft-OutputFormat": "riff-24khz-16bit-mono-pcm",
+        "User-Agent": "synthesize_ssml.py",
+    }
+    payload = f'<speak version="1.0" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="{voice}"><prosody rate="{prosody_rate}" pitch="{prosody_pitch}">{ssml}</prosody></voice></speak>'
+    response = requests.post(endpoint, headers=headers, data=payload.encode("utf-8"), timeout=60)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
+        f.write(response.content)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
